listing.name: Bloodborne (Bloodborne PC)
listing.summary: LanternEngine is a performance-focused Bloodborne PC fork based on bbport and shadPS4. Use your own PS4 CUSA03173 game with update 1.09 on Windows or Linux with Vulkan. The project’s GPU coverage and a full playthrough remain unconfirmed.

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Check that your own PS4 game is CUSA03173 with update 1.09. The project has not established exact accepted file hashes or separate BIOS and firmware requirements.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Follow the project’s Windows or Linux Vulkan setup and use its launcher. You manage the installation and later version changes. Portcove has not qualified the published files.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The fork documents direct PS4 CPU execution. It is maintained by one author, and the launcher’s name alone does not establish a separate implementation from its parent.
